s: December 11, 2025 - In the 1940s, Danish designer Hans Wegner saw a series of photographs of Chinese tradesmen and became fascinated with the chairs on which they were sitting. He set about creating his own version of the Ming chair, incorporating a curved, bent-wood armrest and the namesake back, which had a pronged wishbone shape that allowed for a more graceful silhouette.
